snowflake_query: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) as num_orders, SUM(o.amount) as total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
explanation: This query joins the orders and customers tables on the customer_id column, groups the results by customer, and counts the number of orders and calculates the total revenue for each customer. It then sorts the results by total revenue in descending order, and finally selects the top 3 customers with the highest total revenue.
